adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 source re-review closes rwk-complete-test-0001 as accepted_with_cautions: Table 1 activity rows are source-located, linked DBAASP rows are reconciled, APD6 summary-level conflict is preserved, and strict gates pass.

caution_findings.evidence_context: APD6 AP03763 compresses activity, sequence-analysis, CD, and membrane-action prose into one entry-level comment; source-supported pieces are located, but the database summary remains source_conflict rather than primary assay evidence.
The XML/PDF table header omits the micro sign in the mass unit, while source prose, table footnote, and DBAASP rows support ug/mL; paired molar values are preserved as printed.
No local XML/PDF/supplement text reports mammalian cytotoxicity or hemolysis for acidicin P; this absence is recorded and not backfilled from unrelated database text.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay and experiment rows for Adpalpha, Adpbeta, and combined acidicin P now map to Table 1/Table 2; APD6 entry prose remains a preserved source_conflict caution.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Table 1 was manually repaired into MIC/no-activity rows with raw units, ratios, target, conditions, and locators. Qualitative spectrum rows are captured only for organisms named in source results. No toxicity assay was found locally.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are bounded to membrane/cell-envelope damage, structure-activity mutagenesis, and computational dimer modeling with direct assay types only where source assays support them.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: Accepted with cautions only when strict semantic and publication-quality gates pass and no concrete rework target remains.
